body:
## Objective and completion rule

Complete the robot's physical tests, capture live measurements, calibrate from those measurements, and demonstrate repeatable mission readiness. Coordinator: Nicholas; subsystem owners verify their own calibration/results. All tasks below remain unchecked until evidence is recorded.

Use the [mission-readiness procedures](https://github.com/shauniee/Autonomous-Robotic-Car/blob/main/testing/mission-readiness.md) and [test-recording rules](https://github.com/shauniee/Autonomous-Robotic-Car/blob/main/testing/README.md#run-and-record). MR IDs below refer to those procedures; T IDs refer to the planned integrated trials. This checklist includes the physical work transferred from #123; its documentation was merged in #126.

## 1. Prepare the final test setup

- [ ] Select and record the exact firmware commit, build profile, flashed-image checksum, tester/date, wiring, power source and starting constants for every test session.
- [ ] Prepare a measured track, reference barcodes, ≤30 mm ramps, measured obstacles, measurement tools, console capture, wireless `monitor` capture and camera/scope capture where required.
- [ ] Agree missing acceptance limits in `docs/project-specs.md` Pending decisions before marking the corresponding tests PASS, including distance/turn/height errors, stopping limits, timing margin and finish convention. Do not treat provisional constants or proposals as accepted limits.
- [ ] Append every result to `testing/system/TEST_LOG.md` using the existing MR/test IDs and unique evidence filenames. Link subsystem traces/results as applicable. Record failures and reruns without overwriting evidence; add every recorded video to `docs/week13-plan.md#video-index` and the matching result row.

## 2. Electrical release, boot and stop

- [ ] **MR-01..04:** verify wiring/continuity, disconnected Grove 6 GP26 contact, open GP28 battery-sense jumper, sonar Echo ≤3.3 V before connection, and power-bank polarity. Use one power source at a time; disconnect USB for battery runs.
- [ ] **MR-05:** measure minimum 3V3/VSYS under motor and servo load; compare with agreed limits and check for brownouts/resets. Perform powered load tests only after the unpowered wiring checks pass.
- [ ] **MR-06..07:** capture actual TEST startup/self-test output with motors inhibited; verify GP21 stop and fresh GP20 reset. Separately verify normal firmware boots inhibited and reset does not itself start motion.
- [ ] **MR-09..11:** verify start refusal without a mapping or with an IMU fault; mapping accepted while stopped, rejected while moving, and cleared on reboot. Power off before disconnecting/reconnecting hardware.
- [ ] **T02:** exercise GP21 during follow, turns/distance actions, scan, bypass and recovery. Measure motor-output brake latency separately from physical stopping time/distance; check fresh-reset behavior with causes present and cleared.

## 3. Sensor and motion calibration

- [ ] **MR-12..13:** record mounted line-IR black/white values, contrast/noise under course lighting, calibration cues and barcode black polarity; verify invalid-line status clears only after valid calibration.
- [ ] **MR-14..15:** hand-turn each wheel one forward revolution three times; record counts/signs and encoder-fault detection/clearance.
- [ ] **MR-16 / T06:** calibrate the stationary mounted IMU; verify axes, nose-up pitch and impact/latched-stop behavior. Save labelled stationary, acceleration, braking, turning, climb/descent and impact traces; distinguish encoder-derived turn rate from IMU measurements.
- [ ] **MR-17 / T08:** measure sonar error at 100, 250, 500 and 1000 mm; test open space, angled/different surfaces and no/late/out-of-range echoes. Unknown/no echo must not be treated as clear space or itself trigger a stop; record repeat timing.
- [ ] **MR-18:** verify servo centre, both sweep limits and settling; record calibration without mechanical stall.
- [ ] **MR-19..20:** verify motor forward polarity; measure wheel diameter, track width and wheelbase; record encoder-to-distance calibration.
- [ ] **MR-21..23:** drive 1 m five times; perform 90° left, 90° right and 180° turns five times each, then repeat with one wheel raised on a hump. Record distance, lateral and heading errors against agreed limits.
- [ ] **MR-24..25 / T05:** measure stop distance and stall-detection time; verify latched stop and reset. Test discrete-action completion, timeout and obstacle cancellation.
- [ ] Commit each measured constant separately, rebuild and rerun affected checks. Preserve pre-tuning failures and identify the revision used for final acceptance.

## 4. Live data and real-time behavior

- [ ] **MR-08 / T12:** save Pico-originated `mqtt_client.py monitor` output and snapshot replies. Verify approximately 500 ms telemetry, advancing encoder counts, mission/motion/line states, mapping flag, fault bytes, range/validity, hump count/maximum, barcode/action and obstacle dimensions against physical observations.
- [ ] Verify derived speed/direction from encoder changes and event time/position for barcodes, humps, obstacles and turns. Check units, invalid values, sequence/count/time wrap and event ordering; investigate missing/duplicate events.
- [ ] Capture higher-rate sensor/terrain observations needed for calibration and fault diagnosis, including raw/calibrated IMU, filtered pitch/roll as available, travel and terrain transitions. Add a bounded capture method if needed. Slow MQTT output alone cannot prove short transitions, deadlines or stop latency.
- [ ] **MR-39 / S3-M02:** on the final wireless TEST image, USB only, calibrate and exercise line/white/barcodes plus hand-spun wheels for at least 60 s. Save all `[TIMING]` windows: worst `max_us < 10000` for both `s3_input` and `s3_mission`, `overruns=0`, and agreed D13 margin. Record that TEST excludes motor PWM load.
- [ ] **T15:** separately measure normal-firmware behavior under concurrent motor, sensor, barcode, scan and network load: task release/execution timing, missed deadlines, stop latency, queue/ring occupancy and stack/memory margin. Record agreed limits and actual measurements; TEST timing alone does not cover this load.
- [ ] **T14:** exercise stale/frozen producers, expired motion commands, encoder/stall faults and full diagnostic/navigation/capture buffers. Verify the documented fault/stop policy, bounded processing and no stale-data replay; check stop remains independent of reporting congestion.
- [ ] **SYS-06:** perform controlled task-stall/watchdog injection with wheels raised and one power source. Measure reset time; verify watchdog feeding requires producer progress and reboot inhibits motion.
- [ ] **MR-33 / T13:** interrupt Wi-Fi and broker connections under load, then reconnect. Verify healthy local control and GP21 continue, network faults are reported, current data resumes and no stale commands/events cause movement.
- [ ] **T12:** send malformed and prohibited remote commands; verify rejection without motion. Confirm mapping ACK means installed mapping, not merely receipt.

## 5. Individual track features

- [ ] **MR-26 / S3-P01:** complete three line-follow laps with straights/curves under two lighting conditions; record speed, lap results and video on the final normal image.
- [ ] **MR-27 / T04:** test mapped barcodes in both directions at operating speeds; include unmapped, damaged, partial, unknown and duplicate encounters plus capture/event overflow. Record reads/misses/misreads; require correct actions and no guessed letters/duplicate navigation.
- [ ] **MR-28:** execute left, right, straight and U-turn mappings at cross junctions. Verify action occurs at the junction, not at barcode detection; record print-to-junction offset.
- [ ] **MR-30..31 / T09..10:** measure a box, scan and bypass with space on both sides and with one side restricted. Verify measured-side selection, reported width/depth, vehicle clearance, stationary scan and rejection of scans taken while moving, fresh forward range after centring and return to the original line. Test both sides blocked, unknown clearance, a second obstacle and a wrong crossing; require the documented bounded stop/recovery.
- [ ] **MR-32 / T11:** induce line loss with known/unknown direction, interrupt recovery and introduce an obstacle during search. Verify bounded reacquisition or stop with the correct fault; record recovery duration.
- [ ] **MR-34:** agree/document the finish convention and demonstrate stopping at it.

## 6. Hump calibration and acceptance — MR-29 / D06 / T07

- [ ] Measure the lower practice ramp, one reference slightly below it and one at or near 30 mm; all ≤30 mm. Record actual vertical rise, tool/resolution, profile and photos. Exclude the higher practice ramp as a target.
- [ ] Record mounted geometry/orientation and raised wheel; capture pitch and roll through a single-wheel pass. Verify the pitch-based detector crosses the provisional +3.5° climb and −3.5° descent thresholds. Watch for roll-dominant tilt, reversed axes, filter delay, premature FLAT, missed descent and false impact stops.
- [ ] Verify encoder travel scaling; calibrate the height method/factor against the references. Check the provisional 5 mm cutoff and crest flat window. Record the agreed height tolerance and tested speed range in D06; retain 1 mm/count reporting unless a measured need justifies changing it.
- [ ] With final constants, perform three passes per reference (at least nine). Record actual/reported height, signed error, speed, raised wheel, detector outcome and count increment for every pass. Require one event/count increment per valid complete hump and error within the agreed tolerance.
- [ ] Test larger then smaller humps, then an interrupted/invalid encounter: retain the greatest valid maximum and reject invalid count/height updates. Verify stop retention and new-run reset against the Terrain/Mission contract.
- [ ] Run flat-ground, slip/dynamic-acceleration and incomplete-climb controls; check false humps, baseline drift, line tracking with one wheel raised and GP21 stop. Record unsupported rejection behavior as a failure.
- [ ] Save final S4 traces and MR-29 results; update D06 with measured references, calibrated method/limits and threshold decision. Commit any threshold/constant retuning separately, rebuild and repeat affected trials.

## 7. Final mission readiness

- [ ] Confirm every preceding task has linked physical evidence on the accepted implementation; resolve and retest blocking failures. No build/host result substitutes for robot execution.
- [ ] **MR-35:** from a fresh boot, connect, install an unfamiliar four-letter mapping without recompiling, calibrate and start; record boot-to-start time.
- [ ] **MR-36:** complete a course containing line following, barcode junction actions, ≤30 mm humps and obstacle avoidance; verify correct finish stop and matching telemetry/events. Record runtime, errors and interventions.
- [ ] **MR-37:** achieve three consecutive successful complete runs without code or constant changes. After a corrective change, rerun affected checks and restart the three-run sequence.
- [ ] **MR-38:** reconstruct the route from saved monitor/event output and encoder positions; compare the barcode, turn, hump and obstacle order with the observed course/video.
- [ ] Close this issue only when MR-01..39, S3-M02/S3-P01 and the applicable T01..T16 checks above have recorded acceptance evidence, calibrated values are documented, videos are indexed and no mission-blocking failure remains.
